test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.**

Forsaken or neglected child who has no home and spends most of his/her time on the streets
solution:
The correct answer is **"Waif."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Waif"** means a small thin person, usually a child, who seems to have nowhere to live. (दुबला-पतला, छोटा बेघर व्‍यक्ति (प्रायः बच्‍चा))

 
 
• **Example:** *The kind-hearted woman took in the **waif**__ and gave him a warm meal and a place to sleep.*
 
 
 
• "Waif" is a one-word substitute for a forsaken or neglected child who has no home and spends most of his/her time on the streets.
 
• The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fugitive:** a person who has escaped from captivity or is on the run from the law. ((पुलिस आदि के) नियंत्रण से पहले भागने वाला; भगोड़ा)
 
• **Vulnerable:** susceptible to physical or emotional harm. (दुर्बल और नाज़ुक (जिसे आसानी से शारीरिक या मानसिक आघात पहुँचाया जा सके), असुरक्षित, सुभेद्य, आघात योग्‍य)
 
• **Miscreant:** a person who behaves badly or breaks the law. (परेशान करनेवाला या ग़ैर-क़ानूनी काम करनेवाला; अपराधी)
